scope: Preserve retained junk-dealer, summoned-dealer lifecycle, and contraband content for Publish 14.1 Smugglers while preventing inherited NGE expertise bonuses, proc buffs, secondary payouts, and tiered primary/combat buffs from becoming gameplay authority.

findings: The authenticated Publish 14.1 combat_smuggler family has 19 canonical rows and grants container, terminal, weapon, and armor slicing, pistol combat, feign death, spice crafting, and underworld language comprehension.
Publish 14.1 Smuggler rows contain no expertise_increase_smuggler_loot, expertise_junk_dealer_cut, Feeling Lucky proc, or summoned junk-dealer payout authority.
The corpse inspection command belongs to the later class_smuggler progression and is already retired from corpse menus and dispatch while its compatibility handler remains ungranted.
The summoned dealer command is owned only by the retired expertise_sm_path_off_the_books_1 row; no authenticated Publish 14.1 Smuggler row grants it.

The retained summoned dealer applied one of five NGE buffs on timeout or dismissal. Their tiers were selected by expertise_buff_under_the_counter and expertise_buff_best_deal_ever, and the buffs contain later primary-stat or damage-division modifiers.
Retained later-content junk sales, dealer greeting/profit/lifecycle behavior, and space contraband drops can remain available, but their outcomes must not be modified by an NGE expertise tree.
